description: Ejes viarios de Girona is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by terra.girona.cat. Road axes of Girona, with associated information of its code, type of road and name. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Road axes of Girona" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Girona, Carrer. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
